the_correction_that_matters_most.why_that_is_UNSAFE_as_written: 9a0999fa is 4 days old. `git diff HEAD 9a0999fa` is NOT W1-18's delta — it also reverts everything every other agent has done since. game/src/engine.js alone would LOSE 1,122 lines (41 commits since the revert); game/src/harness/api.js would lose 119 (14 commits). Blind whole-file restore on those files reproduces exactly the disease this piece exists to repair.
the_correction_that_matters_most.what_is_actually_safe: Measured per file whether HEAD has moved since the revert c9603f64. 14 of the 22 outstanding files are FROZEN — zero commits since — so for those a whole-file restore is byte-exact and loses nothing. The rest need a real three-way merge (base 091a6cec, ours HEAD, theirs 9a0999fa).
